query: What hedonic model specifications (attribute set, functional form, estimation window) and decision rules will determine when to apply unit-value versus hedonic adjustments for CPI inclusion?

response.query: What hedonic model specifications (attribute set, functional form, estimation window) and decision rules will determine when to apply unit-value versus hedonic adjustments for CPI inclusion?
response.answer: Hedonic models use attribute sets and functional forms to adjust CPI for quality changes. Unit-value adjustments apply when quality differences are minor; hedonic adjustments are used for significant quality changes. The decision depends on the estimation window's data quality and variability.
